rows.en: Abiiih!! Abi-abi!!
You lot are entering too? I'd love to kill you all right here and now, but...
we'll follow the tournament rules and settle this in a match.
Kikikikiki!!
Come to think of it, a while back some Kamen Rider I'd never seen before was running wild...
Isn't that one entered in the tournament?
Who are you talking about?
You don't know... Hmph! Seems they're no friend of yours, then.
Who's there? Barging in without even knocking...
This is the waiting room of our team, the Alien Alliance!
You're the Hero Team, aren't you?
Were you eavesdropping on our strategy meeting!?
If you're going to spy on us, at least do it without getting caught!!
Once this tournament's over, I'm gonna propose to Seamons.
If I can, I'll win it... but even if I don't, if I just do as well as I possibly can...
I'm sure she'll finally look my way.
Didja know? Whoever wins gets to be ruler of this Cube.
I'll win this tournament and make my name thunder across the universe...
{8074}! The entrance to the Plasma Spark Tower is just through here.
The trouble is, it's been completely sealed off by ice...
...So this is it? The entrance to that Plasma-whatever?
Sure enough... It's frozen solid.
Hey, {8074}. Can't you smash it somehow?
{8074} and the others tried every means they had...
but the wall of solid ice was thicker than they'd imagined, and they couldn't break through.
Tch, no good...
How did it go?
No good, Jack... It won't budge an inch.
Brother Jack, it's no use... It won't budge.
Jack, it's no good... It won't budge.
Jack, it's no good... It won't budge.
Jack, it's no use... It just won't budge...
Jack, it's no good... It won't budge.
Jack, it's no good... It won't budge.
Jack, it's no good... It won't budge.
Gaaaaah!! No good, no good! The damn thing won't budge!!
Jack... I'm afraid we just don't have the power for this.
It's no good, it won't budge...!!
Jack... I'm afraid it's beyond us as we are now.
Jack... I'm afraid it's beyond us as we are now.
So it's as I thought... We tried as well, but we couldn't even make a dent in it.
If we can't get through here, then we'll have to do as Brother Zoffy ordered and...
Guess so. We're joining the game too.
You're right. We'll take part in the game too.
Right. Then we'll take part in the game as well.
Right. Then we'll take part in the game as well.
Yes, we'll take part in the game too.
Yeah, we're joining the game too.
Yes, let's join the game too!
Indeed. We shall take part in the game as well.
Yeah! We're jumping into this game too!!
Right. Then we'll take part in the game as well.
Yes, we'll join the game too.
Understood. We're entering the game too.
Understood. We're entering the game too.
All right. We're entered separately, but if anything happens, let's work together.
"Attention, contestants! Attention, contestants!"
It's an announcement over the PA...!
"The opening ceremony will now begin. All contestants, assemble in the arena."
Everyone, let's hurry! Good luck out there!
Jack's team and the Hero Team headed for the arena where the opening ceremony was being held.
Assembled warriors, I thank you for your patience.
We shall now begin the opening ceremony of the "Regis Fight"!
"Woooooooaaah!!"
I am Master Gundam, who shall preside over this tournament!
"Woooooooaaah!!"
Now then, first allow me to explain the outline of this tournament!
To begin with, its purpose...
At present, this Cube... the "Ultra Cube"... has no "master."
So the Fight shall decide who is truly mightiest, and grant them full authority over this Cube.
In other words, the victor shall be recognized as king of this Cube!
"Woooooooooooooaaaaaah!!!"
In this tournament, power is everything! Hero or kaijin, friend or foe, it matters not...
Those who fight, and fight, and fight on to the very end, the last ones left standing...
shall claim the right to rule as king of this Cube!!
"Woooooooooooooaaaaaah!!!"
Next, the tournament format. It consists of two stages: the preliminaries and the final tournament.
First, the preliminaries, known as "Survival Eleven"! A survival race to decide the 8 teams in the finals.
Those who reach the Plasma Spark Tower, the final tournament venue, within 11 hours...
shall earn the right to compete in the final tournament!

notes.note: Shiomaneking's cry has no precedent in finished slices; romanized as 'Abiiih!! Abi-abi!!'. story_073 (0425 #0.10) repeats it; keep consistent.
One sentence split across #0.2/#0.3; English cut at the same point.
The unfamiliar Kamen Rider is unidentified; gender-neutral 'that one' / 'they' (#0.5).
'Furimuite kureru' rendered 'look my way' (return his feelings); Seamons is female per glossary.
Narration sentence split across #0.5/#0.6; English cut at the same point. {8074} = party leader name.
Jack asks how the party's attempt on the ice went.

#0.10-0.22 and #0.26-0.38 are 13 leader variants. 0414.bla leader chain Pt_Chara_Check 15,14,12,11,5,4,2,1,3,6,7,9,10 = Zero, Mebius, Seven, Ultraman, OOO, W, RX, Rider 1, Den-O (Momotaros), Nu, Zeta, Wing Zero, 00; script default index +12 = 00 (last). Voices confirm: Mebius 'Jack nii-san' polite, OOO 'Jack-san' polite, Momotaros rough #0.18/#0.34, Rider 1 uses 'watashitachi' #0.33.
Identical source for Seven, Ultraman, W, RX, Rider 1 (#0.12,13,15,16,17): identical English. Same for Wing Zero/00 (#0.21/#0.22).
Jack deliberately trails off (Zoffy's order: join the game if the tower route is blocked); the leader completes the thought next.
'Game' kept (Belial's 'game' from story_069). Seven, Ultraman, Nu (#0.28/#0.29/#0.35) identical source, identical English; Wing Zero/00 (#0.37/#0.38) identical. Zeta #0.36 polite.
Unseen announcer (speaker ???); source marks the broadcast with double corner brackets, rendered as double quotes (precedent: earlier slices). Crowd roars (#0.50 etc.) likewise.
'Regis Fight' and 'Survival Eleven' (#0.64) are not in the glossary; rendered from the katakana. 'Plasma Spark Tower' follows the established franchise name.
Sentence runs #0.59-#0.61; English cut at the matching points. 'Kaijin' kept per glossary usage (revived kaijin).
Sentence continues into #0.66; cut at the matching point.

report: All 80 rows translated. Leader-variant order from 0414.bla Pt_Chara_Check chain (Zero first, 00 last), confirmed by voices. Terms not in glossary: Plasma Spark Tower, Regis Fight, Survival Eleven. Shiomaneking cry romanized without precedent.
